sourceChange: Guard helper/companion change-subscription availability publication when the Bool has not changed, including disconnection and cancellation.

environment.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.3.3 (swiftlang-6.3.3.1.3 clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx26.0
environment.configuration: SwiftPM debug XCTest, strict concurrency and warnings as errors

workload.fixture: Existing SkillTextFixture using production SkillsLibraryWindowView and AppModel over isolated real Unix sockets. No production jobs or data.
workload.content: 200 Markdown sections, each containing heading, stable paragraph with emphasis/code/link and two list items.
workload.window: Skills library preview ordered front; Dashboard not opened.
workload.companionNotices: dashboard-only changes.wait replies, 100ms fixture delay between replies. Contents and selection stay unchanged.
workload.measurement: After two seconds settling, 600 asynchronous 100ms sleeps. Whole-test-process user + system CPU from getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF); elapsed from ContinuousClock; layout calls counted on one NSHostingView subclass.

baseline.output: LAYOUT PROBE notice-traffic: passes=603, cpu=17.974794, elapsed=63.982559042000005 seconds

fixed.output: LAYOUT PROBE notice-traffic: passes=1, cpu=0.8912179999999998, elapsed=62.381960583 seconds

reproduction.baseline: Run the same probe with AppModel.swift from sourceBase; run fixed afterward with only the availability guards changed. Restore the optional probe afterward. The patch is archived as evidence, not part of the default test suite.
reproduction.scope: Use a clean, isolated checkout for the optional probe.

limitations: One sequential run per variant; machine-wide load, caches and Chrome Remote Desktop activity were not controlled.
The large preview and regular notice traffic are a synthetic amplification workload, not a reproduction of every production condition.

CPU includes socket-fixture threads and XCTest. Layout count covers the library hosting view, not all AppKit/SwiftUI nodes. Peaks and high-load stack samples were not collected for this isolated comparison.
No installed app was replaced or restarted; production app improvement, Dashboard/library combined scenarios and remote-desktop influence remain unverified.
regression: ChangeObservationTests sends 200 notices on each subscription, then a disconnect/reconnect; expects exactly false/true/false/true availability publications, no hidden Dashboard snapshot reads, and one final false across repeated cancellation.
